title: 0 / HUMAN PORT
purpose: One stable human-facing contact contract whose transport may change without changing what the sender has to understand.

current_surface.transport: local browser composer + native Web Share / clipboard
current_surface.browser_session_handoff_rule: Laconic may pass draft text through same-origin sessionStorage; message text must not be placed in URL query or fragment state.
current_surface.draft_surface_role: local candidate selection and recovery only; HUMAN PORT remains the explicit share/copy boundary
current_surface.drafting_law: DRAFT != SEND; candidates remain local until explicit human share/copy.

intents.meaning: No response required; receipt or awareness is enough.
There is a concrete practical request or action.
Unexpected silence or concern; human attention matters more than automation.

envelope.event_id_semantics: Portable correlation/deduplication identifier for one signal. It is not authority, authentication or proof of identity.
envelope.reply_semantics: RETURN links may carry only the event id in the URL fragment so a later signal can declare REPLY-TO without exposing message text.
envelope.by_semantics: Human-supplied free text only. It must not be parsed into a deadline, reminder or commitment without an explicit downstream action.
envelope.byte_identity_rule: The envelope displayed as RETURN must be the same string passed to Share or Copy.

may: acknowledge receipt when a bound transport can prove receipt
summarize or draft a response under policy
route a practical request to an appropriate private capability
hand off to a trusted human when policy or stakes require it
must: disclose automation when automation is speaking
keep public and private state separate
surface uncertainty rather than inventing personal state
respect per-person, per-resource and per-channel policy
require readback or confirmation when ambiguity could materially change a consequential or irreversible action
leave a RETURN receipt for consequential routing
keep message and draft text out of URL-carried state
preserve exact signal identity across display, copy and share for the same composed signal
must_not: fabricate a live status from silence or stale data
infer permission for external action from familiarity or tone
publish private correspondence to the public surface
take irreversible consequential action without explicit authority
treat an event id or reply token as authentication or authorization

future_bindings.binding_rule: private runtime only; unofficial WhatsApp Web integration
private runtime only; unofficial WhatsApp Web integration
